title: Light-Painting the P-51D Mustang "Happy Jack's Go Buggy"
description: A stunning light-painted photograph of the famous P-51D Mustang fighter "Happy Jack's Go Buggy". We light-paint this amazing aircraft in a hanger in Oshkosh, Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting a 1952 AD-4N Skyraider
description: A cool light-painted photograph of a 1952 AD-4N Skyraider with the American Flag in the background. This unique image was created in the hangar at Soaring By The Sea Foundation in Eugene, Oregon.

title: Light Painting a Restored 1943 P-40 N-1 Kittyhawk with a WWII Willys Jeep.
description: A really pretty light painted photo of a restored 1943 P-40 N-1 Kittyhawk with a WWII Willys Jeep. This amazing image was created at Soaring By The Sea Foundation in Eugene, Oregon.

title: Light Painting a 1943 P-40 N-1 Kittyhawk and a WWII Willys Jeep
description: For this cool light painting, we placed our Canon R5, and our ProMediaGear tripod up on a scissors lift to give us a cool vantage point for this artwork. The P-40 and the Willys Jeep look amazing for up there!

title: Light Painting UH-1H "Huey" N426HF
description: The finished light painted artwork of UH-1H "Huey" N426HF. Like the Cobra helicopter below, we created this cool image at the Army Aviation Heritage Foundation & Flying Museum in Hampton, Georgia. This amazing aircraft is airworthy! In fact, you can actually ride on it at airshows around the country!

title: Light Painting AH-1F “Cobra” N826HF
description: A stunning light painted photograph of AH-1F “Cobra” N826HF created at the Army Aviation Heritage Foundation & Flying Museum in Hampton, Georgia. This amazing aircraft is also airworthy! In fact, you can actually ride on it, and the Huey, at airshows around the country!

title: Light Painting AirCam N74TV
description: A cool light painted photograph of AirCam N74TV. When I saw the hangar filled with remote-controlled aircraft suspended from the ceiling, I knew this would be a really unusual project.

title: Light Painting the Twin Rotax 912S engines on the AirCam N74TV.
description: The Twin Rotax 912S engines on the AirCam N74TV are so incredibly detailed. However, you can't see them from the front of the aircraft. So we created this image to rectify the situation!

title: Light Painting of Piper L-4 N33579 and a Willys “MB” Jeep.
description: Here's the completed artwork of Piper L-4 N33579 and a Willys “MB” Jeep. Joannie and I created this beauty in Carrollton, Georgia.

title: Light Painting Bell 505 Jet Ranger X Helicopter - N505S (Pilot Portrait Version)
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of Bell 505 Jet Ranger X Helicopter N505S, and its pilot (he was actually long-exposure light painted into the image as well). This one-of-a-kind-image was created on a helipad above Lake Norman, in North Carolina.

title: Light Painting Bell 505 Jet Ranger X Helicopter - N505S (Scenic Version)
description: This light painted photograph was the "scenic version" of a Bell 505 Jet Ranger X Helicopter on a helipad over Lake Norman in North Carolina.

title: Light Painting the 2000 Velocity Experimental Aircraft NB32AB
description: Here's the finished light painting of the 2000 Velocity Experimental Aircraft N832AB. This image was create right between two main runways at the Raleigh-Durham International Airport.

title: Light Painting the 2000 Velocity Experimental Aircraft NB32AB
description: By simply turning the aircraft around (I wish it was actually that easy), we created a second cool light-painted photograph of the 2000 Velocity Experimental Aircraft N832AB, this time from the front. Image was light-painted at the Raleigh-Durham International Airport.

title: Light Painting Gearhead Curiois and the Vintage Texaco Station on Route 66
description: Joannie and I created this one, "because we were there". This amazing piece of Route 66 history is "Gearhead Curios" and the Vintage Texaco Station in Galena, Kansas. If you're ever in the area, please stop in and say hello to Aaron, the owner of this cool establishment! Oh, yeah, make shut to take the "Restroom Tour" while you're at it!

title: Light Painting Cessna 182 N225EA
description: Here's the beautiful light painted photograph of Cessna 182 N225EA. This cool light painting project was created at the old hangar and abandoned Control Tower at the RGV Wing Commemorative Airport in Los Fresnos, Texas.

title: Light Painting Douglas DC-3 N728G
description: Just 3 nights after light painting "Old Crow" at the Wednesday night fireworks show, I was at it again with this World War II Warbird, Douglas DC-3 N728G.

title: Light Painting CubCrafters XCub N920RS at Oshkosh
description: A pretty light painted photograph of CubCrafters XCub N920RS. I created this cool image by the airstrip located at Hickory Oaks Campground in Oshkosh, Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting "Old Crow" at AirVenture
description: A stunning light painted photograph of P-51 D Mustang fighter, "Old Crow". We created this cool image during the Wednesday night airshow's fireworks spectacular at the 2025 EAA AirVenture in Oshkosh, Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting the Howard 500 N500LN
description: A stunning light painted photograph of the Howard 500 N500LN created at the Anoka County Airport in Blaine, MN. There were just 17 Howard 500s built back in the 1960's, and this is one of only two of those that is flight-worthy today.

title: Light Painting the Twin Pratt & Whitney R-2800 Double Wasp Engines on the Howard 500 N500LN
description: A really cool light painting of the powerful twin Pratt & Whitney R-2800 Double Wasp engines on the Howard 500 N500LN. We created this amazing image of the Howard 500 at the Anoka County Airport in Blaine, MN.

title: Light Painting a Citation X+ and a Pair of Mercedes Benz
description: A really cool light painting of a Citation X+, with a 2020 G63 Mercedes Benz, and a 2020 Mercedes Benz GTR. The photograph was created in a hangar at Flying Cloud Airport in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.

title: Light Painting a Citation X+ and a Pair of Mercedes Benz
description: The left section of an amazing Route 66 diorama (circa 1958). The buildings in the diorama all were on Route 66 in 1958. This section features Cline's Garage, Cline's Flying C Ranch, the Flyinf=g C Cafe, and Homer's Used Cars Junkyard. There are also many period cars and trucks that were all "aged" the the creator of the diorama, the very talented, Don Bonin.

title: Light Painting a Citation X+ and a Pair of Mercedes Benz
description: This is the Tower Court as it appeared on Route 66 in the 40's. It was very common for motels to to be called "courts", and the nicer ones, like this one, had a garage for each unit.

title: Light Painting a Citation X+ and a Pair of Mercedes Benz
description: In this section of the Route 66 diorama you'll find the beautifully detailed Don Bonin Chevrolet Dealership (named after the diorama's designer and builder). There's also a highly detailed Standard Gas Station that once was on Route 66 in Illinios.

title: Light Painting Piper Dakota N2904R
description: A cool father and son light painted photograph created as a special project for the son's senior year in high school. It includes the son, Eddie, with his pride and joy, his Subaru WRX. Dad, Rudy, is standing by Piper Dakota N2904R, which he pilots. The one-of-a-kind image was taken at Club Cherokee at the Crystal Airport (KMIC) in Crystal, Minnesota.

title: Light Painting and Subaru WRX and Piper Dakota N2904R
description: A Learjet 45XR in its hangar just before light painting the entire scene.

title: Light Painting a Learjet 45XR and a 1978 Pontiac Firebird
description: A cool one-of-a-kind light painted photograph of the pilot's 1978 Pontiac Firebird, and the Learjet 45XR that he flies. This was his very first car and a pretty cool one at that!

title: Light Painting a Beautiful 2013 60th Anniversary Corvette Garden Sport
description: A really cool light painted photograph of a 2013 60th Anniversary Corvette Grand Sport 3LT! This unique image was created in a hangar with 3 corporate jets at AVMATS in the Spirit of St. Louis Airport in Chesterfield., Missouri.

title: Light Painting the Dylke Delta N71AW at the Richard I Bong Airport
description: Photo of Experimental Aircraft, Dyke Delta N71AW, at Richard I Bong Airport in Superior, WI.

title: Light Painting the Dylke Delta N71AW at the Richard I Bong Airport
description: Light painted photograph of Alan White's self-built Experimental Aircraft, Dyke Delta N71AW, at Richard I Bong Airport in Superior, WI.

title: Light Painting the Dylke Delta N71AW at the Richard I Bong Airport
description: Light painted photograph of Alan White leaning on his self-built Experimental Aircraft, Dyke Delta N71AW. Photo was created at the Richard I Bong Airport in Superior, WI.

title: Light Painting World Famous Betty's Pies on Lake Superior
description: A stunning light painting, with the Northern Lights, of "World Famous" Betty's Pies in Two Harbors, Minnesota.

title: Light Painting Our Adorable Granddaughter, Riley, with Her Pink Barbie Cadillac.
description: The stunning finished light painting of the completed bar remodeling project. The project design and construction as done by Julkowski Inc. out of New Brighton, Minnesota.

title: Light Painting Our Adorable Granddaughter, Riley, with Her Pink Barbie Cadillac.
description: An adorable light painted kid's portrait of our sweet granddaughter, Riley, wearing her Barbie dance costume with her Pink Barbie Cadillac. See, you can have just about anything light painted and it turns out amazing!

title: Nate's Cool Light Paintings with His Drums at Torino-Grace High School
description: Nate, his dad, and Michael, on the 50-yard line at Totino-Grace High School. Together, we're creating his cool senior portrait light painting with his drums.

title: Nate's Cool Light Paintings with His Drums at Torino-Grace High School
description: Nate's cool light painted senior portrait with his amazing drum set on the 50-yard line at Totino-Grace High School in Fridley, Minnesota.

title: Nate's Cool Light Paintings with His Drums at Torino-Grace High School
description: A really cool light painted senior portrait of Nate and his drum set on the 50-yard line at Totino-Grace High School in Fridley, MN.

title: Nate's Cool Light Paintings with His Drums at Torino-Grace High School
description: Another light painting version, this time with Nate using his light-up drumsticks on the football field at Totino-Grace High School in Fridley, MN.

title: Light Painting Gregg's Garage Vintage Restored Gas Station
description: A wonderful light painted photograph of a Vintage Restored Gas Station located in Carver, Minnesota.

title: Light Painting Coca-Cola Products
description: My very first completed light painting photograph of some vintage Coca-Cola products. I proudly have this light painting hanging in my studio's camera room. Stop by and take a look at it sometime!
